title: WEDDING INVESTMENT GUIDE
intro: Knox Signature is a luxury hybrid live music and DJ experience designed to shape the atmosphere of your wedding from the first arrival to the final song.
Every event is custom tailored to the venue, timeline, and vision for the day, but the information below provides a starting point for most celebrations.

difference.title: What Makes Knox Different
difference.copy: We are not a traditional DJ company. Knox Signature blends live saxophone, live piano, and curated DJ performance into a single, cohesive experience designed around flow, energy, and intentional pacing. Our focus is not on oversized production or unnecessary extras. It is on creating an atmosphere that feels effortless, elevated, and memorable.

investmentNotes: Most Knox Signature weddings fall between $5,950 and $9,500 depending on ceremony coverage, venue logistics, multiple locations, travel, and event duration.
